config_files.notes: EverSiege uses internal project name KingdomLegacy. Configuration files are in Saved\Config\Windows.

keys.effect: Internal render resolution percentage (50-100).
keys.notes: Native 100 recommended for high-end GPUs. Use in-game upscaling where available.

keys.effect: Shadow and Virtual Shadow Maps (VSM) quality: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
keys.notes: Quality 2 (High) provides clean contact shadows and stable VSM resolution without Epic compute cost.

keys.effect: Lumen Global Illumination quality: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
keys.notes: Quality 3 (Epic) roughly doubles ray budget and surface cache probes. Quality 2 (High) preserves full dynamic indirect bounce lighting while ensuring consistent 60+ FPS during combat.

keys.effect: Lumen Reflections quality: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
keys.notes: Quality 2 provides sharp specular reflections on metallic and glossy surfaces with low overhead.

keys.effect: Texture streaming quality: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
keys.notes: Bandwidth-bound. High-end GPUs with 10GB+ VRAM should keep at Epic (3).

keys.effect: Visual effects and particle simulation quality: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
keys.notes: Quality 2 balances particle density for siege weapons, magic, and projectile effects.

keys.effect: Post-processing passes (bloom, ambient occlusion, depth of field): 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
Draw distance and LOD transition distance: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
Foliage density, draw distance, and wind simulation: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
Material and shader permutation complexity: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=epic, 4=cinematic.
Maximum framerate limit in FPS (0 = uncapped).
keys.notes: Set 2-3 FPS below monitor refresh rate for VRR/G-Sync panels to prevent VSync latency spikes and tearing.

keys.effect: In-game vertical synchronization.
keys.notes: Always False; use G-Sync / FreeSync or driver-level sync.

keys.effect: Texture streaming memory budget in MB.
keys.notes: Higher pool size eliminates texture pop-in during camera rotation on cards with 12GB+ VRAM.

keys.effect: Enables native Unreal Engine 10-bit HDR output.
keys.notes: Set to True on HDR/OLED displays to bypass synthetic Windows Auto HDR and provide direct scRGB luminance.

keys.effect: Caches Virtual Shadow Map pages for static meshes across frames.
keys.notes: Greatly reduces frame time overhead in isometric/siege views by reusing static shadow pages.

keys.effect: Resolution LOD bias for directional Virtual Shadow Maps.
keys.notes: A value of 1 avoids over-allocation of shadow resolution on ultrawide viewports (5120x1440).

keys.effect: Pre-compiles shaders upon level loading.
keys.notes: Reduces traversal and spell-spawn hitching during gameplay.

keys.effect: Enables asynchronous compute queues for shadows and post-processing.
keys.notes: Improves GPU hardware utilization on modern architectures (e.g. RTX 40-series).

keys.effect: Sets the maximum horizontal resolution baseline for texture streaming calculations.
keys.notes: Aligns the texture streamer with super ultrawide (32:9) viewport dimensions.

keys.effect: Enables Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening in the post-process tonemapper.
keys.notes: Counteracts TAA/TSR softness to restore crisp texture and edge definition without halos.

keys.effect: Controls chromatic aberration color-fringing filter.
keys.notes: Setting to 0 eliminates artificial color dispersion and edge blur across the frame.

keys.effect: Controls circle depth-of-field blur passes.
keys.notes: Disabling keeps the entire isometric/siege field in sharp focus.

keys.effect: Controls camera and per-object motion blur.
keys.notes: Eliminates smearing during camera panning and high-speed action.

keys.effect: Maximum server network tick rate for multiplayer sessions.
keys.notes: Prevents Unreal Engine listen servers from clamping tick rate to 30 or 60 Hz when a client connects.

keys.effect: Maximum server network tick rate for LAN / local sessions.
Maximum network transfer bandwidth per client in bytes per second.
keys.notes: Raises bandwidth limit from default 15 KB/s to 100 KB/s to prevent packet queuing during swarm waves.

keys.effect: Maximum internet client bandwidth limit in bytes per second.
Client network connection speed setting in bytes per second.

intro_skip.label: Disable startup splash videos
intro_skip.notes: Renaming publisher and developer splash mp4 files skips directly to the game start.

notes: EverSiege: Untold Ages is developed by Tindalos Interactive on Unreal Engine 5 with DirectX 12.
Internal project identifier is KingdomLegacy. Config files are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\KingdomLegacy\Saved\Config\Windows\.
